plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp boxing S&C build with one gym session each week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main percentage-based lift so later loading is accurate, and the main training work starts in Week 2. With only one weekly session, the priority is crisp power work first, then lower-body strength, then productive upper-body pulling and trunk work without adding unnecessary fatigue to boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and power with simple movements that are easy to learn and recover from alongside boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the key strength and power lifts while trimming wasted volume and keeping output sharp.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster and sharper force expression while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: 1a. Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height that lets every rep stay fast and clean. Stick the landing softly and step down each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if boxes are busy or setup is awkward. Reset between reps and jump for height.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want the simplest low-impact option. Start from a still position and explode up.

exercises.name: 2. Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up in small jumps, then build to one hard top set with solid depth and control. This session establishes your baseline for future percentage work, so stop at the heaviest set you can complete with good form.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your 1RM.

performanceTarget.prompt: Record the load and reps from your top set with honest form.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if shoulder position makes back squat uncomfortable. Keep the same top-set testing approach.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if barbell squatting is not yet safe to perform well. Build to a hard but clean set of 5.

exercises.name: 3. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Pull the elbows back hard and pause briefly at the top. Use a load that leaves 1-2 clean reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need a simpler setup. Keep the torso still and finish with the upper back.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if chest-supported equipment is taken. Keep the trunk braced and avoid twisting.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Press with full control and stop with 1-2 reps in reserve. Keep the shoulders packed and feet planted.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you are comfortable with the setup and have a spotter or safeties.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want the simplest option. Elevate the hands if needed to keep reps clean.

exercises.name: 5. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Brace hard and keep the ribs down. Only roll out as far as you can without losing trunk control.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no ab wheel is available. Keep the same controlled range.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if rollouts bother the shoulders or lower back.

exercises.name: 6. Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Walk tall with short quick steps and a tight trunk. Use challenging loads without letting the shoulders slump.

substitutionOptions.name: Trap Bar Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if dumbbells are limited. Keep posture tall and breathing controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if space is tight. Train both sides evenly.

exercises.name: 1b. Medicine Ball Rotational Scoop Throw
exercises.notes: Throw hard from the hips and rotate through the trunk. Use a non-bouncing or low-bounce ball and reset each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if shoulder comfort is better with a safety bar. Match the same loading intent.
